title: Bad vs Good vs Great Claude Prompts
topic: Prompt quality escalation across 5 builder use cases
notes: Editorial template. Could become a keyword post later: DM the full prompt pack.

topics.good: Give me 10 Instagram post ideas about [NICHE].
topics.great: You are a content strategist for a creator in [NICHE]. Audience: [WHO FOLLOWS YOU] Goal: [FOLLOWERS / LEADS / SALES] Give me 10 post ideas built around problems my audience is actively trying to solve. For each one: the hook, the format (reel / carousel / story), and why it stops the scroll. Previous context: I do not want recycled viral templates. I want ideas specific enough that a competitor could not post them. Think step by step.

topics.bad: Write copy for my landing page.
topics.good: Write landing page copy for [PRODUCT] targeting [AUDIENCE].
topics.great: You are a conversion copywriter writing a landing page. Product: [PRODUCT] Audience: [WHO IT IS FOR] Main objection: [WHY PEOPLE HESITATE] Write the hero section: headline, subheadline, and CTA. Lead with the outcome, not the features. Previous context: I do not want clever wordplay. I want copy a distracted visitor understands in five seconds. Think step by step.

topics.bad: My code does not work. Fix it.
topics.good: Find the bug in this function: [PASTE CODE]
topics.great: You are a senior engineer reviewing my code. Code: [PASTE CODE] Expected behaviour: [WHAT SHOULD HAPPEN] Actual behaviour: [WHAT HAPPENS] Error message: [ERROR] Walk through it line by line, find the root cause, then suggest the smallest possible fix. Previous context: do not rewrite the whole file. Explain why the bug happens so I can catch it myself next time. Think step by step.

topics.good: Explain [TOPIC] like I am a beginner, with examples.
topics.great: You are a patient tutor teaching me [TOPIC]. My level: [BEGINNER / INTERMEDIATE] My goal: [WHAT I WANT TO BUILD] Time: [HOURS PER WEEK] Build me a 30-day plan: what to learn each week, one small project per week, and what to deliberately skip for now. Previous context: I learn by building, not by reading theory. Optimise for shipping something real by day 30. Think step by step.

topics.bad: How can I automate my work?
topics.good: Which of my weekly tasks could I automate with AI?
topics.great: You are an automation consultant auditing my week. My role: [WHAT YOU DO] Repetitive tasks: [LIST 3-5 TASKS] Tools I already use: [TOOLS] Pick the 2 tasks with the best effort-to-payoff ratio and design the automation for each: trigger, steps, and tool (Zapier / n8n / Claude). Previous context: I am not technical. I want automations I can build this weekend, not an enterprise system. Think step by step.
